relation_to_primary_study: Same frozen corpus; not a new independent sample or model evaluation
transport: Loopback TCP, separate receiver process, 4-byte big-endian payload length, one-byte adaptive compression marker, zero-length termination frame
gate: Every received AST canonical all-field digest equals the sender's original AST; zero delivery/order/meaning differences
limits: No TCP/IP/TLS packet-overhead or network latency superiority claim; same existing synthetic data; valid-input operational validation, not adversarial receiver security testing
network_scope: 127.0.0.1 only; no remote services or credentials
